name: Doctor Doom

moves.name: Gauntlet Blast
moves.description: Concussive energy from the gauntlets, enough to stagger the Thing.

moves.name: Force Field
moves.description: Personal shield that absorbs hits until three heavy blows in two rounds collapse it.

moves.name: Mystic Bolt
moves.description: Sorcerous blast; requires speech and marks this as the true Doom.

moves.name: Binding Ward
moves.description: Spoken ward that roots a foe in place for a round.

moves.name: Jet Boots
moves.description: Rises above the melee to a balcony or ledge.

moves.name: Electrified Grapple
moves.description: Seizes a foe and discharges the armor's shell into them.

moves.name: Backhand
moves.description: A contemptuous armored slap that sends a man across the room.

moves.name: Doombot Decoy
moves.description: A Doombot takes his position; the Doom on the field may no longer be the true one.

moves.name: Castle Defenses
moves.description: Turrets, traps and gas in Castle Doom; home arena only.

moves.name: Time Platform Displacement
moves.description: Shunts a foe out of the fight for two rounds; once per arc.

moves.name: Offer of Surrender
moves.description: Spends the round demanding the foe kneel; a refusal steels his resolve, an acceptance ends his attacks.

leitmotif: Slow pipe-organ march in a low minor key over a mechanical pulse; a single piano line when he is alone.
